pages.headline: sppw1
pages.body:
## Nutshell
I am June. I keep a small garden and I teach my neighbours to grow food.

## Why it matters
I am into growing food - the moment a seed becomes dinner.

## What it means
A street where every family grows something and shares it.

## How to apply it
To teach ten families on my street to grow their own food.
To own a small greenhouse and give my children fresh food all year.

## What's in it for you
Grow a little every day and share what grows.

pages.headline: SPP Bakery
pages.body:
## Nutshell
I bake bread for my neighbours every Saturday morning.

## Why it matters
Fresh bread made to order, still warm, at your door on Saturday.

## What it means
I am building a small bakery. The goal is twenty regular customers by Christmas.

## The vision
A street where every family grows something and shares it.

## How to apply it
To teach ten families on my street to grow their own food.
